storyboardBeats.narration: Car shakes when you hit the gas?
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot from behind the steering wheel looking at the tachometer needle, needle visibly stuttering/bouncing as the driver's foot (out of frame) presses the accelerator, shallow depth of field, subtle cabin vibration, dim interior ambient light, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: That jolt is a misfire, one cylinder skipping.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Engine bay wide shot, hood open, engine idling with a visible slight roughness/vibration in the block, warm daylight, slow push-in dolly toward the cylinder head, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: A worn plug or a tired coil can point there.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Split-feel sequence: extreme macro of a spark plug being lifted from its socket showing worn/rounded electrode, cross-fade-free hard cut to extreme macro of an ignition coil pack being unclipped from its cylinder, both under a bright work-light, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: A steady check engine light is one clue.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro on a dashboard check-engine icon, steady non-blinking amber glow, static hold, soft key light reflecting off the gauge glass, calm mood, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Blinking means stop. That misfire level can damage the catalytic converter.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Same check-engine icon now strobing rapidly, color grade shifts warmer/more urgent, slight handheld shake for urgency, hard cut to an under-car shot of the exhaust catalytic converter housing with heat-shimmer haze, 9:16 vertical framing

Diagnostic scan tool plugged into the OBD-II port under the dash, screen showing a generic fault-code readout (no real DTC asserted, illustrative only), technician's gloved hand (no face) operating the tool, warm garage lighting, 9:16 vertical framing

Wide shot of a tire shop garage bay interior, bay door partially open to daylight, tools racked in the background, no readable signage or branding in frame, warm end-of-day light, static hold — SAVE freeze frame per the render-integrity contract's 3s end-hold convention, 9:16 vertical framing
